name: Agentic Control Plane — Gateway API
description:
The public, gsk_-key-authenticated surface of the ACP gateway: agent profiles, run summaries,
self-introspection (cost / usage / decisions / traces), delegation-chain child-key minting,
scoped-token issuance, the governed model proxy, and the MCP endpoint.

**Rate limits.** Rate-limited endpoints return IETF draft-7 `RateLimit` / `RateLimit-Policy`
headers on every response and a 429 with the same headers when exceeded.

**Errors.** Three envelopes coexist and are documented per-endpoint: `{ error: string }` on
/api/v1/*, `{ error: 'validation_failed', details }` on schema-validated bodies, and the
OpenAI-compatible `{ error: { message, type, param, code } }` on the model proxy.

**Feature-flagged surfaces.** `/api/v1/keys/child`, `/api/v1/scoped-tokens`, and
`/v1/sandbox-tenants` are deployment-flagged; when disabled they 404.

Human docs: https://agenticcontrolplane.com/agents/configure-as-code — agent-facing site
index: https://agenticcontrolplane.com/llms.txt
